title: Time-domain broadband planar nearfield acoustic holography based on the discrete orthonormal stockwell transform
authors: Hefeng Zhou; Kun Song; Haoran Gu; Yongxian Wang; Pan Xu; Yun Zhao
matched_query: time-domain broadband planar nearfield acoustic holography DOST sound field reconstruction
reasons: authoritative metadata verified from Elsevier ScienceDirect
summary_en: A broadband time-domain planar nearfield acoustic holography method based on the discrete orthonormal Stockwell transform. It reconstructs nonstationary sound fields jointly across space, time, and one-third-octave bands while substantially reducing storage and computation relative to STFT-based time-domain PNAH, with numerical and engine/tire experiments.

title: Real-time photoacoustic imaging with freehand light delivery and augmented reality guidance
authors: Junhao Zhang; Cynthia Li; Muyinatu A. Lediju Bell
matched_query: real-time photoacoustic imaging augmented reality freehand light delivery ultrasound transducer tracking
reasons: optical source and ultrasound receiver spatial registration
authoritative metadata verified from PubMed and Elsevier
summary_en: A real-time augmented-reality guidance system that jointly tracks a freehand laser source and ultrasound transducer for photoacoustic imaging. The system renders the laser beam and live acoustic image in a shared spatial frame, reducing mean static targeting error by 58% and enabling tissue-hidden vessel visualization for surgical guidance.
